issues.evidence: threedgrut/model/model.py default_initialize_from_points: rots = torch.rand(...) stored as-is
issues.fix: Store the raw draw (gsplat normalises internally) or list it as a gap.

issues.problem: Observer points / scene extent use train cameras only; official uses all COLMAP cameras (train+test) for both get_observer_points and cameras_extent.
issues.evidence: dataset_colmap.py:573 cameras_extent from all extrinsics before split; runtime.py:92 camera_extent uses train split
issues.fix: Already listed as gap 6/7 in report; keep (avoids test leakage), effect a few %.

issues.problem: gsplat eval3d max alpha 0.999 and no 0.0113 min-response cut vs official 0.99 / 0.0113 (render/3dgrt.yaml). The eval3d-response probe reference hard-codes 0.999, i.e. it validates gsplat, not the official clamp.
issues.fix: Keep as documented fidelity gap 1; note probe encodes gsplat's clamp.

issues.problem: The UT-parameter fix is correct but nearly irrelevant for undistorted Mip-NeRF 360: UT only drives tile bounding/culling. Reviewer check (200 random Gaussians, pinhole 320x240): plugin vs gsplat rasterization(with_ut=True,with_eval3d=True) RGB max diff 1.6e-3, mean 7.7e-6; same visible count. Do not attribute any PSNR difference to it.
issues.evidence: scratch check comparing ss_3dgut Renderer to gsplat.rasterization defaults

issues.problem: The paper's headline claim (distorted/rolling-shutter cameras) is supported only at renderer level (probes: UT moments vs float64 under OpenCV/fisheye, UT closer to MC than EWA, fisheye render peak). No training-level evidence. A partial validation is possible without licensed data: render fisheye GT views from a trained pinhole scene (or synthetic scene) and train plugin-side through ss_3dgut.cameras, comparing to a rectified-crop 3DGS baseline.
issues.evidence: splatstudio/data.py:67-71 rejects non-pinhole / nonzero k1..p2; ScanNet++/Waymo licensed
issues.fix: Optional follow-up experiment; otherwise keep the claim labelled 'renderer-level only'.

issues.problem: Per-scene 'Ours − 3DGS paper' deltas (garden −0.51, counter +0.33) mix two different 3DGS numbers (paper's own 3DGS row 27.26 avg is not the 3DGS paper); single-scene deltas of this size are within run-to-run noise. Official README re-run (27.18 / 29.14) is a better absolute target for code-faithful runs.
issues.fix: Report both paper and README re-run targets; interpret deltas with ±0.2 dB noise.

equation_coverage.code: gsplat Cameras.cuh via renderer.py:render_ut (ut_params alpha=1,beta=2,kappa=0); probe ut_moments vs float64 reference
renderer.py:render_ut (conic + eps2d 0.3 used for tiling only)
rasterize_to_pixels_eval3d; max alpha 0.999 vs official 0.99, no 0.0113 min response
gsplat eval3d backward; probe eval3d_gradient rel err <1e-6

probe_assessment.why: Compares kernel conic/means2d to independent float64 UT at alpha=1 (rel err 1e-6) with tolerance 2e-3; gsplat default alpha=0.1 gives ~1% cov diff and would fail; EWA would fail under distortion.
Strong-fisheye KL to MC: UT 0.0010 vs EWA 0.0092; swapping UT for EWA flips the inequality.
Per-pixel alpha vs ray-space formula (4e-7) and requires >20x separation from 2D EWA rasterizer (0.21).
All parameter gradients vs float64 autograd compositor; catches backward errors.
Peak at analytic equidistant projection, 35 px from pinhole projection; dropping camera kwargs fails.
Checks accum == ||grad||*dist/2 across steps with the runtime's step/zero_grad order, clone/split/prune routing and 300/100/3000 cadence; 2D grads or 100 cadence fail.
Analytic nearest-camera scales and seeded unit quats; kNN init would fail.

fidelity_gaps_confirmed: gsplat 1.5.3 rasterization() does not forward ut_params (rendering.py:383-405, 722-740) so with_ut=True silently uses UnscentedTransformParameters() defaults alpha=0.1, require_all_sigma_points_valid=True; the plugin's direct calls pass ut_params correctly with matching positional/keyword signatures of fully_fused_projection_with_ut and rasterize_to_pixels_eval3d.

Official configs/render/3dgut.yaml (used by paper/3dgut/unsorted_colmap.yaml via base_unsorted) sets ut_alpha 1.0, ut_beta 2.0, ut_kappa 0.0, margin 0.1, require_all false, k_buffer 0 — matches plugin.

Official strategy/gs.yaml: densify every 300 (500<s<15000), thresholds 2e-4, relative_size 0.01, split N=2 scale/(0.8*2), prune opacity 0.005 every 100, reset every 3000 to 0.01 with Adam state zeroed, prune_scale/prune_weight/density_decay disabled — all match density.py. Clone-then-split with zero-padded grads for clones matches gs.py.
Official step order (grad buffer post-backward, densify after optimizer step) matches runtime order (hook captures grad before opt.step; after_backward after step).

Official base_gs.yaml LRs/eps/position schedule (1.6e-4*extent -> 1.6e-6*extent exp), SH +1/1000 to 3, 30k its, opacity 0.1 init, init scale 0.01*nearest observer, random rotations — match runtime + plugin. Features cosine scheduler applies only to NHT 'features', not SH.

Protocol: scripts/benchmark/mipnerf360.sh uses dataset.downsample_factor=4 outdoor / 2 indoor, loader reads images_4/images_2 folders (gsplat_image_downscale false), test_split_interval 8 — matches our native data. Paper supp. Tab. 7 garden 26.90, counter 29.03 match paper_results.json.
Background black (official) vs white (runtime); max alpha 0.999 vs 0.99; no min-response cut; StopThePop culling not used; sorted MLAB variant not implemented.
Distorted-camera training unreachable: splatstudio/data.py:67-71 rejects non-pinhole models and nonzero distortion; ScanNet++/Waymo licensed.

Smoke 380k vs 843k Gaussians at 2k steps is consistent with the log: 5 densify rounds (600..1800, ~+20-25% each) vs 15 at the 3DGS 100-step cadence, plus smaller official init scales. bench.py max-gaussians 12M is ample.
summary: Implementation faithfully follows the official 3dgrut GS-strategy unsorted 3DGUT configuration for Mip-NeRF 360. All builder claims verified: gsplat's rasterization() drops ut_params; the plugin's direct kernel calls are correct; UT and densification hyper-parameters, schedule, init, loss, LRs and protocol (images_4/images_2, llffhold 8) match the official configs. Remaining differences are documented kernel-level gaps (0.999 vs 0.99 max alpha, min-response cut, culling), white background and camera-extent source. Probes are mechanism-level and would fail on removal. Distorted-camera contribution is validated only at renderer level. Approved for benchmark; no critical or major issues.
